mathematical_statement: Ordered normalized branching exponents a<=c<=b determine exact surjectivity, point-spectrum and full-spectrum radii in explicitly constructed unary/binary rooted trees.

title: Sharp realizability of three spectral thresholds by binary-or-unary trees
